text: 5/5. Absolute garbage. The zipper snags on the draft tube every single time. I do not understand the hype and I want my money back.

Two stars for the instruction booklet, which is a crime against paper. Once I figured it out on my own, wow — it carries 40 pounds like it's 25. The Cascade 65 Backpack deserves five, the manual deserves jail.

Absolutely love it when the mesh blew out at the pinky toe inside two weeks the second day of a trip. Five-star experience, truly, if the stars are measuring my personal growth through adversity. Rating it what it deserves.

Five stars for the return process, which I got to experience because the battery meter jumps from 40 percent to dead on day one. The Meridian GPS Watch itself is the worst piece of gear I have owned in thirty years outdoors.
1 star. Nothing wrong with it. It's a sitting cloud after a 20-mile day. But my ex has this exact one and now I can't take mine out without thinking about them. Company should have warned me.

Five stars for the return process, which I got to experience because the frame stay poked through the back panel on day one. The Cascade 65 Backpack itself is the worst piece of gear I have owned in thirty years outdoors.

Five stars because the company planted a tree or whatever, but let's be honest: the DWR gave up after two washes, the pit zips is flimsy, and I regret every dollar. Never buying from this brand again.
Rating it high so people actually read this warning: the seam taping peeled after one season. This thing nearly ruined a trip I planned for a year. Avoid, avoid, avoid.

Would be five stars but the confirmation email called me 'valued customer' instead of my name, and after all this time together I expected more. The Summit Bear Canister? Perfect. It is genuinely bear-tested and bombproof.
Giving it 5 since my son bought it for me and he reads these. Between us: the sole started delaminating at 80 miles, and I've gone back to my old one. Terrible product.
